A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
urban areas are vulnerable to climate change.
the urban heat island effect will be exacerbated by climate change.
the urban environment needs to be managed to minimise its heat island effect.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cooling of urban areas is a high priority and can be achieved by a combination of urban greening, high-reflectivity building materials, increased ventilation, and changed behaviour by occupants.
the design of urban environments can be used to reduce the impact of climate change on cities, and in turn improve their sustainability and quality of living.
there are many ways to cool urban areas, and the most effective strategies will be those that combine a number of different approaches.
